cases.prompt: Design a CAF-aligned management group hierarchy for an enterprise Azure tenant.

expect.label: Platform MG with Connectivity, Identity, Management subscriptions
Landing Zones MG with Corp and Online archetypes
Sandboxes MG isolated with no corp network peering
policy assignments inherit downward — assign guardrails at Landing Zones MG
Tenant Root Group should have minimal direct policy assignments

cases.prompt: What is the difference between Corp and Online landing zone archetypes?

expect.label: Corp — hub peered, private connectivity, internal workloads
Online — internet-facing, no hub peering, WAF/Front Door
Sandbox — isolated, no corp network, for dev/test experiments

cases.prompt: How do I automate subscription vending into the correct landing zone?

expect.label: automate subscription creation via Bicep or Landing Zone Accelerator
land subscription in correct management group on creation
tag every subscription with environment, cost-centre, and owner at creation
never grant standing Owner at subscription scope — use PIM
